Performance.summary: Apple MacBook Air 15-inch M4 2025 is a slim, fanless, lightweight macOS laptop powered by the Apple M4 chip. It features a 15.3-inch Liquid Retina display, 10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, up to 32GB unified memory, up to 2TB SSD storage, 12MP Center Stage camera, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, MagSafe 3 charging, Thunderbolt 4 ports, and all-day battery life. It is suitable for students, creators, office work, business productivity, coding, video calls, media, and daily professional use.
Performance.Processor: Apple M4 chip with 10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and 120GB/s memory bandwidth
Performance.Battery: 66.5 Wh lithium-polymer battery, up to 18 hours video streaming, up to 15 hours wireless web
Performance.Keyboard: Backlit Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Force Touch trackpad
Performance.Camera: 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View and 1080p HD video recording
Performance.Audio: Six-speaker sound system with force-cancelling woofers, Spatial Audio support, and three-mic array with directional beamforming
Performance.Trackpad: Force Touch trackpad with pressure-sensing capabilities and Multi-Touch gestures
Performance.Display: 15.3-inch Liquid Retina LED-backlit IPS display, 2880 × 1864 resolution at 224 ppi, 500 nits brightness, P3 wide color, True Tone, and support for 1 billion colors
